title: Mercury mock UI
description: Seven quiet banking-UI vignettes built from divs: a dark accounts list with raised cents, a slate virtual card over blurred copies, a bill with floating picked-out chips, an invoice form with a repeat toggle, a frosted upload bar, a tree of transfer rules, and a teammate role picker. White sheets float on warm paper or misty blue panels.
